task: PRS-HOOK-01: verify that runtime observations belong to the prepared workspace
impact: The adapter could accept an outside-workspace observation with the matching session and turn.

rule.expected: A native trigger must belong to the host-selected workspace.
rule.observed: Fresh review reproduced lexical containment accepting an outside path; the integrated revision corrects it.

reproduction.steps: In a disposable adapter fixture, supply matching session/turn and cwd=/workspace/allowed/../other.
reproduction.actual: The earlier check delivered the event; after refusing parent segments it remains pending with mismatched-workspace.
reproduction.limits: This reproduces an actually encountered review finding using synthetic data; no native lifecycle session was run.

workaround: Use normalized host paths and the corrected adapter; retain the regression test.
proposedChange: Reuse PR63 and its audit record; do not create a new upstream ticket for the already corrected root cause.
